scenes.keyframe_visual: Priya alone at her desk, laptop split between a paused exit-interview video and the Excel tracker, headphones half on one ear
scenes.camera: static, slow push in on her face and screen

dialogue.line: Wait. He said my name. Twice.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: Every flag... same time she's with him upstairs.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

scenes.micro_acting: she scrubs the video back with one finger, then drags the tracker column down, lips moving as she counts dates
scenes.narrative_job: Priya finds the timestamp pattern linking Anu's cabin visits to every flag

scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun taping shut a cardboard box with his stapler and mug inside, Priya walking up holding the exit-interview clipboard
scenes.camera: handheld following Priya, settling on both faces

dialogue.line: Sign here properly, Arjun. Not like last time.

dialogue.line: Properly? Like Anu signs for her money?

dialogue.line: What money. What are you saying.

scenes.micro_acting: Priya's hand freezes mid-handoff of the clipboard, Arjun smirks and keeps taping
scenes.narrative_job: plant Arjun's cash reveal, Priya's first alarm

scenes.keyframe_visual: Arjun leaning back against the taped box, tape gun still in hand, Priya standing stiff with the clipboard lowering
scenes.camera: static medium, slow push in on Priya

dialogue.line: Heard she was counting cash, behind the chai stall.
dialogue.voice: Indian man, late 20s, smooth confident sales register, quick laughs

dialogue.line: Cash from where. She's unpaid, Arjun, she's an intern.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

dialogue.line: Ask her yourself, na. I'm just clearing my desk.

scenes.micro_acting: Arjun clicks the tape gun shut, raises his eyebrows, Priya's jaw tightens and she doesn't answer
scenes.narrative_job: reversal beat: Arjun's cash sighting lands fully on Priya

scenes.keyframe_visual: Anu's empty desk, phone face-up buzzing against a stapler, screen glowing with a voice-note icon addressed to 'Vikram Sir', Priya passing softly out of focus behind it
scenes.camera: static insert, rack focus from blurred background to sharp phone screen
scenes.micro_acting: phone vibrates once, screen light flickers on then dims, Priya's footsteps slow near the desk without stopping fully
scenes.narrative_job: plant: phone notification object, Priya clocks it in passing

scenes.keyframe_visual: Priya standing alone in the corridor, light visible under Vikram's cabin door, exit form still gripped in her hand, Arjun's box on a trolley behind her

dialogue.line: Do I go in... or I ask her first.
dialogue.voice: Indian woman, late 20s, warm even tone, careful word choice

scenes.micro_acting: she grips the form tighter, feet don't move, eyes stay on the lit door
scenes.narrative_job: cliffhanger: confront Vikram or protect Anu
